title: IDF may attack camps of displaced people after Gaza City, says ex-general
summary: Yaakov Amidror says ‘central camps’ could be next target, as aid workers there say they have been warned of attacks Middle East crisis – live updates Israeli military forces are likely to mount new attacks into parts of Gaza now crowded with hundreds of thousands of displaced people once they have concluded their current offensive into Gaza City, a former Israeli national security advisor and general has said. Yaakov Amidror, who served as national security adviser to Benjamin Netanyahu from 2011 to 2013 after decades in the Israeli Defence Forces (IDF), said that the “hard core” of Hamas was in Gaza City but that “another chapter” could follow after the offensive there: an attack into the “central camps” area further south.
